practice.q: Drop the agents that were stopped or failed before reading their findings.
practice.hint: Remove the null entries from the array.
practice.why: agent() resolves to null for a stopped or failed agent; reading .findings on null throws.

practice.q: Which first line does a workflow script need?

options.why: meta comes first, as a plain object literal with a name and a description.
Scripts cannot import anything. agent() and the other helpers are globals.
The body is top-level code with top-level await, not an exported function.

practice.q: Put the review panel's run in order.
items: The read-only session calls the Workflow tool with the name review-panel
Three lens agents start in parallel
Lenses that were stopped return null and are dropped
A skeptic starts for each important finding
The script returns the findings that survived, and only they reach the session
practice.why: The script holds every step in between; the session sees only the final return value.

practice.q: You want each lens's skeptics to start as soon as that lens is done. Which helper fits?

options.why: parallel() waits for the whole list before you can start the next round.
pipeline() sends each item through the stages on its own, with no barrier between items.

options.text: A for loop with await inside
options.why: That runs one lens at a time, which is slower than either helper.
